messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@brightbyte.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.procure@brightbyte.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Burst repricing request

Hi Naomi,

We had an unexpected traffic spike over the weekend during a limited beta (approx. 3x baseline for ~6 hours). Our app hit the token quota and several customer flows degraded. Procurement asked me to get a written path for a temporary quota increase + how the overrun will be billed — they need a PO reference they can use while they formalize a larger commit.

Can Redwood provide: 
- A short-window uplift (48 hours) and an explicit per-token rate for that uplift, or a clear overrun billing rate;
- An option for the surge to be covered by a staged PO (procurement can issue a short-term PO held against an upcoming invoice) so we don't get stuck with a collection hold;
- Any supporting logs for the spike (we can share traffic samples).

Deal: BR-4721. We attached a small sample of the traffic (traffic-logs.csv) for your ops team. Procurement (Sam) is on cc and will need an invoice line item labeled something like 'temporary-burst-topup' if we go that route.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Product
BrightByte

--
Attachment: traffic-logs.csv (csv stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Burst repricing request

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick note and the log sample. Sorry you ran into disruption during the beta. 

Short answers up front: yes, we can do a short-window uplift and we can provide a staged PO path so procurement can issue a hold against an invoice. A couple of details we'll need to confirm the exact pricing and risk:

1) How long do you want the uplift to run? You mentioned 48 hours as one possibility — we commonly do 24/48/72 windows.
2) Is this repeatable over the next 30 days (do you expect another surge) or was this a one-off event?

Provisional commercial proposal (subject to final verification by finance/legal):
- 48-hour uplift: capped burst rate at $0.0012 per token for all tokens above the current quota (first 48 hours).
- If traffic remains elevated after the uplift window, standard overrun true-up applies at the normal per-token rate for the month.
- As a gesture for the disruption, we can apply a one-time credit of 10% against the overrun invoice if you sign the staged PO within 5 business days.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with the provisional numbers (provisional-pricing.xlsx). Ben — can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with the 10% one-time credit and the $0.0012 cap for short windows? Lauren — could you capture a short mutual action plan for Elena's team so we have rollback timing and monitoring?

Elena — if procurement needs an invoice stub language we can supply 'temporary-burst-topup (48hr uplift) - invoice to follow'. Let me know preferred window and I can route the approval immediately.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM Pricing & Programs
Redwood Inference
